label: nx_box_help1_010
text:
This right here is the Pokémon Box screen!
On this screen, you can move Pokémon in and out of the games
you connect to—easy peasy, Nomel squeezey!

label: nx_box_help1_020
text:
Tap the ZL or ZR Buttons, and you can change your operation mode.
The red cursor is your regular mode, nice and simple.
The blue cursor lets you swap Pokémon one after another.
And the green cursor lets you select multiple Pokémon at once!

label: nx_box_help1_025
text:
If you select the Box Spaces button down here, you can see a list of all
the Boxes you’ve got squirreled away in each of your Box Spaces!
You can swap around entire Boxes while you’re in your Box Spaces,
so why not try to keep things nice and tidy?

label: nx_box_help1_030
text:
If you press the Newest 30 button, you’ll be whizzed straightaway to
a special view that lets you access the Boxes where you tucked away
the 30 newest additions to the cozy Pokémon HOME!

label: nx_box_help1_040
text:
When you’ve had enough of organizing your Boxes for a time,
press the + Button to save your work. This is really important!
If you don’t save, all the hard work you did will disappear...
like it never even happened! Oh no!

label: nx_box_help2_020
text:
You’re using the Basic Plan right now, which means you’ll be able to
keep up to 30 Pokémon in your Basic Box.
Sure, it’s not a gazillion. But golly, it’s plenty to get you started with!

label: nx_box_help2_030
text:
If you added a whole bunch of Pokémon to Pokémon HOME using the
Premium Plan, you can only take out the last 30 Pokémon you added!

label: nx_box_help3_010
text:
When you want to receive whole Boxes at a time, you’ve gotta
have enough empty Boxes to accommodate them all!

label: nx_box_help4_010
text:
On this screen, you can see ALL the Pokémon in your Pokémon HOME
Boxes and in the Boxes you’ve got saved in the game you’re currently
connected to.
They’re all here for you to take a peep at!

label: nx_box_help4_020
text:
Use the Y Button and you can change the order they’re sorted in.
And you can sort ’em any old way you like. From highest Attack to lowest,
from lowest Defense to highest... There’s no shortage of methods to try!

label: nx_box_help4_030
text:
Use the X Button to set a number of different filters and home in
on just the Pokémon you want to see!
You can filter for moves, Abilities, and so much more!

label: nx_box_help_syn1_010
text:
Boy howdy, have you heard the news? You can now link this app
to Pokémon Champions—and this is the place to do it!

label: nx_box_help_syn1_020
text:
From this screen, you can choose Pokémon to send as visitors to
battle in Pokémon Champions or welcome back those who are on
their way home.

label: nx_box_help_syn1_030
text:
Just keep in mind that as long as a Pokémon is off visiting in
Pokémon Champions, you won’t be able to send it to another
Pokémon video game.

label: nx_box_help_syn1_040
text:
If you DO have a Pokémon off visiting in Pokémon Champions
and you decide you want to bring ’em to a different game instead,
you’ll first need to head on over to Pokémon Champions in order
to send ’em home. Don’t forget that!

label: nx_box_help_syn1_050
text:
You can send up to 30 Pokémon over to Pokémon Champions in
one go, and the max number you can send to visit in total is a
whopping 1,000 Pokémon! Can you believe it?

label: nx_box_help_syn2_010
text:
On this screen here, you can see all the Pokémon you’ve got in
Pokémon HOME, all lined up and ready for you to inspect.

label: nx_box_help_syn2_020
text:
You can change how they’re sorted using your L Button. Want to check
out who’s got the highest Attack or Defense stat? Or maybe the lowest?
There are SO many ways you can sort around here!

label: nx_box_help_syn2_030
text:
And with the R Button, you can search for more specific things
to quickly find the Pokémon you’re after. For example, you can
look for a certain move or Ability. There are lots of options!

label: nx_box_syn_save_01
text:
While a Pokémon is visiting Pokémon Champions, you will
be unable to take the following actions with that Pokémon
in Pokémon HOME.
・Sending it from your Boxes to other games
・Releasing it from your Boxes
・Applying markings

or Pokémon: Let’s Go, Eevee! anymore.

It’ll show up in places like Pokémon selection screens and your
Pokémon list.
